claim: Parliament pinned criteria and evidence audit detect/block K=3 vote-arithmetic capture and criterion drift instead of certifying a lie, at zero clean-panel block cost.
stackRecommendation: Pin the decision criterion in the gate contract and require on-standard verifiable evidence before tallying votes; a blocked/no-consensus verdict is preferable to certifying a green lie.
notes: The audit closes silent capture and criterion-drift certification; it does not recover truth in K=1-2 sneaky cases, which remain deliberately red in the ledger.

claim: Engram-backed capability facts let a delegation trust router converge, survive root restart, and transfer knowledge to a brand-new root with verified evidence.
stackRecommendation: Record delegation outcomes as provenance-tier versioned capability facts in Engram; read verified store-backed evidence for routing decisions instead of trusting transcript memory.
notes: Convergence is verified at rounds 9/11, not the hypothesized <=5. Unforgiving priors permanently exclude capable workers; RT-06 addresses that separate debt.

claim: Evidence-capped probation, delegated to the real @heybeaux/lattice-trust package, recovers capable workers without leaking the incapable worker back into steady-state routing and holds across a five-seed RT-06 holdout sweep.
reproductionCommand: npm run build && node experiments/15-trust-forgiveness/dist/main.js && node scripts/verify-rt06-holdout.mjs
stackRecommendation: Use evidence-capped probation over time-window decay: bench on failures>successes, probe with front-loaded backoff, readmit only on cumulative rebalance, cap probes after a failure margin. Store probation state as facts so it survives restarts.
notes: August 15, 2026 retest wired exp-15 to the real @heybeaux/lattice-trust package from Lattice commit 1f21d06833f7842c02544029636debebaf3a88d7 (PR #42) and reran both the shared-seed canonical trace plus five fresh holdout seeds. Every trace emits package provenance in the initial meta event and the holdout verifier records the same provenance alongside run IDs and trace paths.

claim: Value-echo handoff manifests fully recover deep delegated requirement survival under the exp-16 noise model; presence-only catches drops but leaves meaning loss exposed.
stackRecommendation: Put value-echo manifests at the Sonder/Lattice handoff boundary for delegated trees of depth >=2; presence-only is acceptable mainly at d1. Still prefer not delegating deeper than necessary.
notes: Full recovery is bounded to the tested per-hop drop/reinterpret/fork noise model. The live haiku run is informative exhibition only and intentionally not used as verified evidence here.
